WITH rating_per_day AS (
    SELECT 
        f.rating,
        AVG(f.rental_rate / f.rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_by_rating
    FROM film f
    WHERE f.rental_rate IS NOT NULL 
      AND f.rental_duration IS NOT NULL 
      AND f.rental_duration > 0
    GROUP BY f.rating
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_by_rating) AS overall_avg
    FROM rating_per_day
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT 
        rpd.avg_per_day_by_rating,
        rpd.avg_per_day_by_rating - oa.overall_avg AS excess
    FROM rating_per_day rpd
    CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
    WHERE rpd.avg_per_day_by_rating > oa.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
    AVG(avg_per_day_by_rating) AS avg_per_day_of_above_average,
    AVG(excess) AS avg_excess
FROM above_average
